summary: Local macOS test-only quantized-QR portfolio with typed residual/norm rejection, three fixed coordinate-order policies, one monotonic aggregate budget and sequential factor lifetime. Seven tests include 18 actual 128-element physical beam configurations covering three scales, three numberings and both signs. All sampled candidates retain the original eigenvalue and automatically selected mass-weighted anchor, pass unchanged residual/unit-norm gates and independent physical reassembly after constructed JSON readback. Four or seven actual certificates suffice for these samples; the enforced worst-case cap is nineteen across three attempts. Operator faults, malformed certificates and cancellation stop immediately, including errors with numerical-gate words. Fresh final certification failure does not retry or publish. Static work/payload formulas are not timing/RSS evidence, and sampled renumbering success is not general coordinate invariance. This is validation and recovery-control evidence, not production fallback, public tiny-beam success, multimode, live Agent, installed or remote qualification.
